matched_baseline: same seed, duration, initial state, registered drive and observation-noise namespace; controller command identically zero in SHAM
analysis_window: exclude first 15 s identically in SHAM and ACTIVE
intermediate_gate: median dT2 > 0 AND positive dT2 seeds >= 2/3 AND controller integrity PASS for all seeds
long_duration_gate: median dT2 > 0 AND positive dT2 seeds >= 2/3 AND controller integrity PASS for all seeds

supporting_I_SO_classification.SUPPORTIVE: median I_SO > 0 and positive I_SO seeds >= 2/3
supporting_I_SO_classification.CONTRADICTORY: median I_SO <= 0 and positive I_SO seeds <= 1/3

secondary_rule: Secondary directions do not veto Minimum C1 unless a frozen numerical, actuator, saturation, integrity, or safety gate fails; all adverse secondary effects remain visible.
failure_routing: If intermediate T2 gate fails, perform focused measurement-suitability audit. I_SO-primary V2 is forbidden unless T2_PRIMARY_MEASUREMENT_UNSUITABLE is established for measurement-level reasons.
anti_target_shopping: No primary, direction, seed, duration, metric definition, or pass rule may change after this freeze based on fresh outcomes.
claim_ceiling: bounded in-silico reliable and controllable mechanistic digital twin MVP
